_comment: Example config for the three plot tools in tools/, all of which take
Each entry in `groups` becomes one curve (the two success plots) or its
own pair of PNGs, one per actor kind (the position plot). Each entry in a
group's `runs` is one series -- typically one seed. A `runs` entry that is
a LIST is a resume chain: those run dirs are stitched into a single
continuous series, with the child winning at any overlapping total_steps.
Paths point at a run's glob dir: <RUN_OUT_DIR>/wandb/run-<ts>-<id>/glob
Any top-level key starting with '_' is ignored, so this block can stay.
